payload.summary: Site is live at https://visualjc.github.io/ez-baccarat/ (HTTP 200, assets 200 under /ez-baccarat/assets/). Jim had enabled Pages himself against the chore/pages-deploy SOURCE branch, which served the unbuilt index.html and 404d on /src/main.ts — that branch was then deleted by the PR merge. Repointed Pages at gh-pages / root via gh api PUT repos/visualjc/ez-baccarat/pages after running scripts/deploy-pages.sh from main. Route chosen because the push credential lacks workflow scope: branch deploys need only repo scope, so docs/deploy/pages.yml stays parked and optional.
